description: Shared bot-wide tallies in the reserved namespace. System modules bump these; channels never see them.
degraded: The loyalty service is unreachable. Counters are temporarily unavailable.
emptyBody: Create one here; system modules can then bump it by name.
valueHint: An absolute value, not an increment. Modules bumping this counter will continue from what you set.
confirmDeleteBody: "{name}" and its value are removed for the whole bot. Modules that bump it will recreate it from zero.
